hold verb

classical

Traupman 328

teneō, tenēre

verb, second conjugation

Other words

  • capiō, capere, cēpī, captum — hold, contain

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 328

  • gerō, gerere, gessī, gestum — hold (an office)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 328

  • habeō, habēre, habuī, habitum — hold (a meeting)

    verb, second conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 328

Examples

  • Firmē tenē.

    Hold tight.composed

  • Nōn tenet.

    It won’t hold.composed
